items.name: HippoRAG
items.description: [NeurIPS'24] HippoRAG is a novel RAG framework inspired by human long-term memory that enables LLMs to continuously integrate knowledge across external documents. RAG + Knowledge Graphs + Personalized PageRank.

items.name: HippoRAG-Lite
items.description: (v0.1.0 异步化三大函数，新增三大函数)去除了HippoRAG2中的torch，vllm，甚至openai（以requests和siliconflow api取代）；完全由api和本地cpu实现功能

items.name: HippoRAG
items.description: An implementation of the HippoRAG agentic architecture based on the paper.

items.name: Mini-HippoRAG
items.description: Mini-HippoRAG is a smaller version of HippoRAG which is a novel RAG framework inspired by human long-term memory that enables LLMs to continuously integrate knowledge across external documents. RAG + Knowledge Graphs + Personalized PageRank. I added a different version of this here as my own implementation.

items.name: memoRaxis_MemGPT_Raptor_LightRAG_HippoRAG
items.description: Memory/RAG sandbox for LLM agents: compare Single-turn, Iterative, and Plan-and-Act paradigms with pluggable backends (pgvector, Letta/MemGPT, RAPTOR，LightRAG and HippoRAG)
